description:
End-to-end flow on a single tool:
  1. Create a new tool via prompt (Generate Code -> Create Tool).
  2. Attempt to upload a non-.py file to that same tool -> rejected.
  3. Upload a real .py file -> accepted, then click Update Tool.
  4. Run every function listed in the 'Test your tool' panel.

Note: at the time this was written, clicking the panel's Test button
resets the input fields but never populates the Output panel (confirmed
with a 60s wait and zero network activity on click), so step 4 verifies
the interaction itself rather than asserting a specific output value.
